name: beam
description: Property keywords for the 3DEC beam structural element. Assign with 'structure beam create ...', set elastic behavior with 'structure beam cmodel ...', then set these with 'structure beam property <keyword> <value> [range ...]'.

property_groups.name: Properties
property_groups.description: 'structure beam property' keywords (2D-only keywords omitted; 3DEC is 3D).

properties.description: direction-y vector whose projection onto the element cross-section defines the \(y\) -axis of the element coordinate system
moment of inertia with respect to element \(y\) -axis
moment of inertia with respect to element \(z\) -axis
plastic moment capacity in Y and Z
plastic shear capacity in Y and Z [9.x-only: absent from the live 3DEC 7.00 'structure beam property' enumeration.]
plastic shear capacity in Y [9.x-only: absent from the live 3DEC 7.00 'structure beam property' enumeration.]
plastic shear capacity in Z [9.x-only: absent from the live 3DEC 7.00 'structure beam property' enumeration.]
shear coefficient for transverse shear deformation in the \(y\) -direction (Timoshenko beam element only) [9.x-only: absent from the live 3DEC 7.00 'structure beam property' enumeration.]
shear coefficient for transverse shear deformation in the \(z\) -direction (Timoshenko beam element only) [9.x-only: absent from the live 3DEC 7.00 'structure beam property' enumeration.]
torsion constant [9.x-only: absent from the live 3DEC 7.00 'structure beam property' enumeration.]
Young's modulus (stress). Live-enumerated by 3DEC 9.7.47; was missing from this file.
Poisson's ratio. Live-enumerated by 3DEC 9.7.47; was missing from this file.
polar moment of inertia. 7.0-only spelling: the live 3DEC 7.00 enumeration has moi-polar and lacks torsion-constant; 9.x renamed this slot to torsion-constant.

verification: Live-verified 2026-08-14 against 3DEC 9.7.47 ('structure <type> property' enumeration WITH elements present): documented set confirmed; young/poisson added from the live enumeration. NOTE: 'spacing' is NOT enumerated by 3DEC 9.7 (see cable note). 3DEC 7.00 Release 161: live enumeration = cross-sectional-area density direction-y moi-polar moi-y moi-z plastic-moment plastic-moment-y plastic-moment-z poisson thermal-expansion young (13 with range). plastic-shear family, shear-coefficient-y/z and torsion-constant are 9.x-only; moi-polar is the 7.0 spelling of torsion-constant.
